build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template where two dynamic balls must touch each other
create_dynamic_balls: create two dynamic balls with configurable positions and radii in a PHYRE scene
define_spatial_relationship: define a touching spatial relationship between two bodies using C.update_task
skip_invalid_params: skip invalid template parameters by raising SkipTemplateParams when balls overlap or go out of bounds
set_solution_tier: set the solution tier metadata to BALL using C.set_meta
